entries.title: Parks and Trail
entries.description: This dataset provides information on parks and trails within the City of Montgomery, offering residents and visitors opportunities for outdoor recreation, exercise, and relaxation. It includes details on park locations, available amenities, and trail networks that connect various parts of the city.

entries.title: Downtown Parking
entries.description: This dataset contains information related to parking in downtown Montgomery.

entries.title: Community Centers
entries.description: This dataset provides information on the Community Centers in the City of Montgomery, including locations, hours, and amenities.

entries.title: Fire and Police Station
entries.description: This dataset shows all of the fire and police stations across the City of Montgomery.

entries.title: Tornado Shelter
entries.description: This dataset provides the locations of designated tornado shelters within the City of Montgomery. It includes information on shelter accessibility and availability to help residents find safe locations during severe weather events.

entries.title: Code Violations
entries.description: This layer displays the locations of code violations across the city.

entries.title: Weather Sirens
entries.description: This dataset shows the locations of weather sirens throughout the City of Montgomery.

entries.title: Education Facility
entries.description: This dataset provides the locations of educational facilities within the City of Montgomery, including universities, public schools, and private schools. It offers insight into the city’s educational infrastructure, helping residents, researchers, and policymakers understand school distribution and accessibility.

entries.title: PLACES and 500 Cities: Data Dictionary
entries.description: This dataset provides a data dictionary for PLACES and 500 Cities releases. For each measure, the data dictionary provides the measure ID, measure full and short name, measure category ID and name, year of BRFSS data used to generate the estimate by release year, and frequency BRFSS collects data about the measure.
